prompt: Implement Load in env.go so it reads configuration from environment variables. APP_PORT: integer port, default 8080 when unset or empty; return an error if it is not an integer or is outside 1..65535. APP_HOST: default "127.0.0.1" when unset or empty. APP_DEBUG: true only when the value is exactly "true" or "1" (case-insensitive for "true"); anything else, including unset, is false. Do not change the Config type or the Load signature.
